messages:
Elaine M: Quick heads-up — noticed our weekly dashboard has a weird spike in MQLs the day after the webinar. can someone eyeball attribution? :eyes:
Mike P: saw that. Looks like email->webinar channel suddenly jumped. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/metrics/leadflow (view-only)
Tara S: I pulled a cohort view — conversion rate up but SQLs not following. possible bad UTM or a duplicate landing page?
Javier (Analytics): ran a quick query, see this sample: `SELECT count(*) AS mqls, utm_source, date_trunc('day', created_at) AS d FROM leads WHERE created_at > '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 2,3 ORDER BY d;` — email_webinar row spikes on 2026-03-20
GrowthBot: [alert] Attribution anomaly detected: email_webinar increased 360% WoW in leads (auto-tag: attribution-spike-20260320)
Elaine M: ok. two threads: (1) fix dashboard so it doesn't overstate (2) check inbound lead router / tag hygiene. who can take 1 and 2?
Mike P: I can take 1 — I suspect our aggregation uses first_touch by default. I'll add a filter for last_touch and a 7d window to compare.
Tara S: I'll dig into routing rules — there was a recent change to merge utm_campaign and creative into `campaign_key`. maybe that caused deduped tags to map differently.
Javier (Analytics): also recommend a short audit of landing pages — one of the webinar CTAs had an old query string still appending `?utm_medium=email` + a tracking param from the webinar host, causing two different utm_source values to co-exist. pulling sample rows now and will share CSV.
Elaine M: great. priority list: 1) Mike update dashboard (last-touch vs first-touch comparison) 2) Tara audit router rules + confirm lead routing logs 3) Javier share CSV + cohort plot for conversion to SQL by channel 4) Ops: hold off on changing routing until we confirm (no flips during business hours)
Mike P: quick note — when I switch to last_touch the spike drops by ~60%. seems like attribution window choice is the culprit. will push a `compare_view` with both metrics in 15m.
Tara S: found one landing page `pages.redwood.com/webinar-xyz?src=email` that is redirecting via marketing partner and appends `utm_source=partner` after redirect. that explains mixed first-touch values.
Javier (Analytics): uploaded `mql_sample_20260320.csv` to the shared folder /Marketing/Attribution/audit-20260320. summary: 420 MQLs marked email_webinar first_touch, of which 170 had partner in final query param.
Elaine M: thanks. for the weekly KPI review on Monday, can we include a small note in the deck explaining attribution nuance + updated metric (last-touch baseline) so execs don't misread the spike?
Mike P: will add slide and a short footnote: "reported MQLs use last-touch 7d window; first-touch shown for context".
Tara S: I'll queue a routing rule test in staging to normalize campaign_key building (strip partner param and prefer `utm_source` canonicalization). will report results here.
Javier (Analytics): ETA for CSV + cohort plots: 45m.
Elaine M: perfect. thanks team — feel free to ping me if you need signoff on any routing fixes. :thumbsup:
